start: Settings, the card 'Download a backup', the owner of an online gym

user_sees: 'Download every member, plan, payment and check-in as an Excel file. Keep it on your phone or computer. We suggest once a month.'
Two files arrive: '<gym name> data <today>.xlsx' and '<gym name> data <today> (full copy).json'
'Downloaded: an Excel file and a full copy.'
must_not: Only one of the two files, with the success words
A second download started by a double tap

user_sees: Sheets About, Members, Plans, Memberships, Payments, Check-ins, Enquiries, Expenses; money in rupees; each row carries the member's name
must_not: Times that are hours away from India time with no word saying so
Any of the gym's data left out of a file called 'all your gym's data' (shop orders and products, workout and diet plans, trainers and bookings, staff, measurements, member messages)

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the button
user_sees: The button waits for the internet and says so
must_not: A dead button with no reason

steps.action: Tap the button when the browser cannot make the file
user_sees: 'Could not make the file. Try again.' in red
must_not: 'Last downloaded on …' moved to today after a failed download

steps.action: Let the browser block the second file
user_sees: A word that the full copy was not saved
must_not: 'Downloaded: an Excel file and a full copy.' when only one file was saved

steps.action: Sign in as front-desk staff and open Settings
must_not: Staff downloading every member's phone number and address

start: A gym with a voided receipt, a cancelled membership, an archived member and a removed member

steps.action: Download and open the Payments and Memberships sheets
user_sees: The voided receipt is there with 'Voided' true and why; the cancelled membership with 'Cancelled' true
must_not: Voided or cancelled rows missing, so the file disagrees with the receipt numbers

steps.action: Find a payment of the removed member
must_not: An empty name or an error

user_sees: A second pair of files; 'Last downloaded on' stays today
must_not: The date line going back to 'Not downloaded from this browser yet.'

start: The downloaded files on the owner's phone or computer

user_sees: Every member's mobile, email, date of birth, address, emergency contact and notes
must_not: Members of another gym or another branch the owner did not open
Sign-in keys, PINs or codes in the Excel file or the full copy

steps.action: Read the card for what happens to the file
user_sees: A word that the file holds members' personal details and should be kept safe
must_not: No warning at all before a file of every member's details is saved on a shared computer
